result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians in a commercial/industrial setting.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the foreground intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing phases.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, supported by a painted median with delineators. However, the wide roadway and industrial-commercial land use create a car-centric environment with significant crossing distances and limited physical protection for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the street.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may partially block the view between pedestrians and turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb line.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while narrowing the perceived street width.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk with curb ramps and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the environment lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions, and parked vehicles near the crossing may limit visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image may obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with a marked continental crosswalk and functional curb ramps. However, the lack of a median refuge, street trees, or bike lanes creates a high-exposure environment for pedestrians. Commercial land use and parked vehicles near the intersection further complicate sight lines and safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four or more lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or island increases exposure time to moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce crossing distance.
